metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire during February than October from 2014 to 2017?

data.raw_code:
```python
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [102.3, 14.7], [107.6, 14.7], [107.6, 10.4], [102.3, 10.4]
])  # Rough Cambodia bounding box

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fires
collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1')  # Terra Daily Fire
feb_filter = collection.filterBounds(cambodia).filterDate('2014-02-01', '2014-03-01')
for year in [2015, 2016, 2017]:
    feb_filter = feb_filter.merge(
        collection.filterBounds(cambodia).filterDate(f'{year}-02-01', f'{year}-03-01')
    )

oct_filter = collection.filterBounds(cambodia).filterDate('2014-10-01', '2014-11-01')
for year in [2015, 2016, 2017]:
    oct_filter = oct_filter.merge(
        collection.filterBounds(cambodia).filterDate(f'{year}-10-01', f'{year}-11-01')
    )

# 3. Check Collection Sizes
feb_count = feb_filter.size().getInfo()
oct_count = oct_filter.size().getInfo()
print(f"February images: {feb_count}")
print(f"October images: {oct_count}")

if feb_count == 0 or oct_count == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    raise SystemExit(0)

# 4. Process Fire Pixels (FireMask band: values ≥7 = fire)
def process_fire(img):
    fire = img.select('FireMask').gte(7)
    return fire.set('date', img.date().format())

feb_fire = feb_filter.map(process_fire).sum()
oct_fire = oct_filter.map(process_fire).sum()

# 5. Count Valid Fire Pixels
feb_stats = feb_fire.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=cambodia,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9,
    bestEffort=True
).get('FireMask').getInfo()

oct_stats = oct_fire.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=cambodia,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9,
    bestEffort=True
).get('FireMask').getInfo()

print(f"February fire pixels: {feb_stats}")
print(f"October fire pixels: {oct_stats}")

# 6. Validate & Answer
if feb_stats is None or oct_stats is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif feb_stats > oct_stats:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
```
